svg.title: Multimodal tuberculosis detection. A distilled EfficientViT on 4,200 chest X-rays fused with a symptom MLP, trained with focal loss, 94 percent F1, explained with Grad-CAM and SHAP.

g.text: A distilled EfficientViT on 4,200 chest X-rays, fused
with a symptom MLP and trained with focal loss.
Grad-CAM and SHAP explain every positive call.
